title: mailbox-v1
description: Canonical mailbox.send / mailbox_halt contract (lp-v62i.1.1). Platform owns this shape. Agent dual-write (lac-r9w.1.1) copies field-for-field. SoT: wayfinder/agent-mailbox-v1.md. nonce IS externalMessageId. from is a gateway stamp, never model-settable. Consumers validate a payload against one $defs entry.
$comment: Bead lp-v62i.1.1 / parent lp-v62i.1 / epic lp-v62i. Schema version 1. Do not invent fields the wayfinder map does not name. Do not import BFF chat-store types.

schemaVersion.description: mailbox-v1. Additive; do not fork fields.

idNoColon.description: Branded id. Colon is illegal (session-key delimiter). Whitespace is illegal.

personaId.description: PersonaId. One mailbox address. Not a user id. Not Jack. Not a connector mark.

threadId.description: BFF thread_id. Not a channel name.

nonce.description: This IS externalMessageId on the wire. Dedupe key is nonce only. Tool path: UUID per send. Prose @ path: prose:{turnId}:{to}:{room}. Same nonce is an idempotent no-op (no second bubble, no second wake). Do not dedupe on (from,to,room,text).

connectorMark.description: Composer @ connector mark. Not a persona. Not a mailbox to. Parser leaf uses this; no wake.

mailboxTo.description: Exactly one persona id. Not a list. bad_to when Jack, empty, self (runtime), or a connector id mistaken as a persona.

mailboxSendInput.description: Model-visible mailbox.send tool input. Gateway stamps from and tenant_id; they are absent here. nonce IS externalMessageId on the wire. One to (persona id). room is BFF thread_id. No attachments in v1.

text.description: Message body. Extra @ in a tool-call body is text only. Only to wakes. No attachments in v1.

mailboxSendStamps.description: Gateway stamps. Not model-settable. from is the session persona, never spoofed.

mailboxAppendRequest.description: Internal POST body the gateway sends to BFF append. Send input plus from/tenant_id stamps. Types only in this package; BFF leaf implements the route.

mailboxHaltInput.description: mailbox_halt input. Only lead tool + Jack's button. Non-lead persona calling halt is forbidden. from is absent.

mailboxErrorCode.description: Fail-closed send/halt errors. not_found: unknown room or unknown to. forbidden: from not on channel roster; guest write to someone else's 1:1; non-lead halt. frozen: halt or fuse freeze in effect. fuse_tripped: send that would exceed 40/hour or 8 consecutive a2a. bad_to: Jack, self, empty, connector id mistaken as persona. dead_room: scheduled fire into a deleted thread.

mailboxAppendResult.description: BFF append response: ok + message_id, or a locked error code.
